attBesluta.text: Love it. Why didn't I get one sooner. Sturdy and easy to use.
Solid and well built. i got them for canoes so had to add dowels for the arms to be long enough. They were about 2” too short
hello, for years my kayaks were piled on the ground beside my garage. now they are stacked neatly behind my house on the best kayak stand ever made! thanks Dan

I've had this for 3 months now. It was super easy to assemble and very adjustable. We have 3 kayaks and 3 paddle boards on it with no issues. It came with wheels but we did not need them as it's in grass right now.

It’s a good product and easy to assemble. It was a little smaller than I expected considering I wanted to place three kayaks on the rack, It possible but really best for two. Picture gives the impression it’s larger than it is

I just received this last week. It was easy to put together and will suit my needs very well. I would prefer the storage arms were screwed to the frame as the u bolts make it a bit wobbly and flimsy. I will be putting it against the wall so it should be protected. Also 4 locking wheels would be better. It seems a bit flimsy, but at that price point I'm not surprised.

Bardzo dobry zestaw. Szkoda, ze sa problemy z kontynuacja produkty. Szkoda, ze system nie pozwala na rozbudowe lub dowolna konfiguracje w gore. Jak raz wybierzesz to juz z tym zostaniesz. A szkoda poniewaz konstrukcja bardzo sprzyja mozliwosci rekonfiguracji.

Bought September 26 to raise and lower my wind turbine, I bought this and adapted it to raise my wind turbine. Once fitted it proved perfect for the job. The quality is great and being a boat item will stand the weather although I intend to fit a box cover. Very pleased with it, it also features 2 speeds. A great buy for any job and good value.

Bought this item to help skid out large sections of trees on a tree arch. Has plenty of lifting power for my needs. Only criticism is the hard to manage steel cable both winding and unwinding. It must be steered on every wrap or you get tangled.
Haven't used them yet, but ordered them to be able to swap out when I clean the current filters. Great value and quick shipping!
